emergingRockets.name: Marvisak/VIctory
emergingRockets.description: An attempt at running GTA VI on PC

emergingRockets.name: trustno1-coder/VIctory-NVIDIA
emergingRockets.description: VIctory (Xbox Series compatibility layer) tuned for NVIDIA RTX cards: Series X at 2560x1440 with DLSS, about 26-30 fps on an RTX 5070, DLSS frame generation 2x-6x, an F1 settings menu and F3 stats panel, open water without dark blocks. Built on many repos combined into one. No game files or NVIDIA files included.

emergingRockets.name: fxceless/victory-fork
emergingRockets.description: Work-in-progress fork of VIctory: getting an Xbox Series title to render and run on a Windows PC. No game files.

emergingRockets.name: ProjectLeonida/mandy
emergingRockets.description: A continuation of Leonida, the Xbox > PC port interface for GTA VI

emergingRockets.name: nexu-io/opengame
emergingRockets.description: The Super Game Agent — the Unity & Unreal for AI agents, with 100+ viral games to remix. Turn 20+ coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek, etc.) into a full-stack AI game studio. Build and publish 3D & mini-games to WeChat, Douyin, TikTok, Telegram, itch.io, and more.

emergingRockets.name: alesha-pro/llm.asm
emergingRockets.description: Qwen3-0.6B inference (12 KB), bare-metal bootable OS (22 KB), and from-scratch Mini-GPT trainer with live Braille TUI (32 KB) in 100% pure x86-64 NASM assembly. Zero C, zero libc, zero dependencies.

emergingRockets.name: os6/nospeaker
emergingRockets.description: make your macbook's trackpad talk using its haptic motor

emergingRockets.name: Reukix/Reloc
emergingRockets.description: iOS accessory-level location simulator over local loopback (iAP2 / MFi-v3 / NMEA)

emergingRockets.name: Avaneesh-Inamdar/Stream-Tube-Desktop
emergingRockets.description: Native YouTube client for Windows in Rust, with SponsorBlock, DeArrow and Return YouTube Dislike built in

silentClimbers.name: Pixel679-cmyk/windows-titlebar-blur-customizer
silentClimbers.description: Customize Windows 10 and 11 title bar effects with Aero, Acrylic, Mica and advanced DWM blur effects.

silentClimbers.name: ZigZagBoi1/ScarlettPort
silentClimbers.description: Native PC port layer for an Xbox Series X|S title: the game's x64 code runs on your CPU and its RDNA2 GPU code is recompiled for your graphics card. Bring your own files.

silentClimbers.name: Indigo-0167/universal-game-mod-manager
silentClimbers.description: Free Windows game mod manager to discover, install, update and manage universal Unity and Unreal Engine mods.

silentClimbers.name: umbradev315/ffmpeg-video-audio-converter
silentClimbers.description: Free open-source FFmpeg GUI for Windows to convert video and audio, batch process media, and analyze quality.

silentClimbers.name: Umbra9179/clipboard-history-manager-windows
silentClimbers.description: Free open-source Windows clipboard manager with searchable history, image previews, tags, editing and backup.

silentClimbers.name: DeadInternetStudios/100x-engineer-skill
silentClimbers.description: 100x is a skill by a former Cursor engineer that turns prompts into formally verified, production-ready code

silentClimbers.name: peak85-sketch/stardew-valley-mod-manager
silentClimbers.description: Free open-source Stardew Valley mod manager for Windows with SMAPI support, mod updates and custom profiles.

silentClimbers.name: solv4626/steam-achievement-manager-windows
silentClimbers.description: Free open-source Steam Achievement Manager for Windows to manage game achievements and edit Steam game statistics.

silentClimbers.name: Basil0879/steam-game-idler
silentClimbers.description: Free Steam idler for trading card farming, achievement management, playtime boosting and multi-account automation on Windows.
